messages.subject: Cannot get eventReactive to work
parts:
I have an application where ui.R has a textInput box and an actionButton: predict.

From ui.R
          textInput(inputId = "text", label = "Input Text"),
          actionButton("predict", "Predict Next Word")


server.R performs lookups to a data table using the text input and renders a textOutput. Each time the user inputs or changes the text, I want her to click the button before the lookup code executes. Based on the Action Button reference document, the behavior I want seems to require eventReactive. I have tried: 

shinyServer(
    function(input, output){
        eventReactive(input$predict, {
            output$next_word <- renderText({
                      do lookups
             })
         })
     }
)

But nothing happens when I click the action button. (If I comment out the eventReactive function, the code works fine in reactive mode, but the shiny server freezes after running for a bit which is why I want to throttle execution with the action buttton.)

What am I missing?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Cannot get eventReactive to work
parts:
Hi Tim, can you try something like this?

shinyServer(
    function(input, output){
        lookups <- eventReactive(input$predict, {
            # do lookups and return a result
        })

        output$next_word <- renderText({
            lookups()
        })
     }
)

When you call output$next_word <- renderText(...), this isn't giving a command to "render next_word right now" or anything; what you're saying instead, is "this is how one would go about rendering next_word". So you only ever want to make that assignment once, and if the body of the renderText(...) uses reactive expressions or reactive values, then it'll automatically know when it should execute and re-execute.
